text:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding runbook step 3 (shortlink) is 404ing when I follow the flow. Noticed during smoke test. Anyone own that runbook? :wave:

mira-docs: Thanks for the report. Can you paste the failing URL? I can open a quick PR if it’s just a broken shortlink. :mag:

alex: Sure — hits 404: https://short.redwood/runbook-onboard-step3 and the full path shows /docs/onboarding/runbook#step-3

pat: I can take a look tomorrow. If it’s a redirect missing we can re-add the shortlink mapping in the redirects table. Need the exact slug though.

alex: full slug in the page frontmatter is `shortlink: runbook-onboard-step3` — seems like the redirect row is gone after the URL cleanup in Feb. Attaching tiny curl output: ```curl -I https://short.redwood/runbook-onboard-step3``` ```HTTP/2 404```

mira-docs: Thanks. I’ll open a micro-PR to reintroduce the redirect and add a test. @pat — can you review when you have a moment? I’ll target a tiny patch so it’s low risk.

pat: Yep. Ping me in the PR. If it’s just a redirects YAML add + test, I can approve quickly.

alex: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2142 — small YAML row + one-line test. Marked reviewers: @pat.

docs-bot: Automated link-checker scan found 1 failed link in /docs/onboarding/runbook (step-3) at 2026-03-22T09:12:07Z — ticket auto-created: DOCS-423

mira-docs: Linking DOCS-423 in the PR description and added the test. Also leaving a note in the runbook frontmatter to avoid future silent deletions.

alex: awesome — thanks both. If it’s green I can merge after pat approval.

pat: Reviewing now. If CI passes I’ll approve and self-merge after lunch. :+1:
